notes:
Summary:
- Customer: mid-market SaaS vendor for omnichannel support. Primary goal: ticket deflection via RAG knowledge agent + top-5 reranking quality for suggested resolutions. Tight latency SLOs: target p50 <= 150ms, p95 < 350ms for combined retrieve+rerank. Volume profile: peak 400-600 qps during EMEA hours, baseline ~80 qps.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Indexing scale: expect initial 2M docs (KB articles, past tickets, product docs) growing to 8-10M over 12 months. Need incremental ingest and partial reindex.
- Embeddings: prefer 1536-2048 dim vectors; evaluating Redwood-verified open models vs in-house transformer. Cost per embedding and storage footprint are key.
- Reranking: client requires strong top-5 precision / NDCG@5 target >= 0.78 on their eval set. Will run our canonical reranker + a smaller on-device reranker for fallbacks.
- Latency/throughput: end-to-end retrieve+rerank must meet SLOs. They are highly cost-sensitive — want Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching, quantization).
- Fallbacks/routing: prefer routing to lower-cost model variants when cost threshold hit, but must maintain top-5 quality baseline. Region-aware routing (eu-west primary) and graceful degrade to cached responses if models unavailable.
- Security: EU data residency or private deployment required for PII class incidents. SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 90 days, KMS integration mandatory.

POC plan and metrics to validate:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): ingest 250k subset, run offline eval for embeddings recall@100 and reranker NDCG@5. Metric gate: NDCG@5 >= 0.75 to continue.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks): scale to 2M index, measure latency at 100/250/500 qps. Gate: p50 <= 150ms at 100 qps, graceful degradation at higher load with autoscale.
- Cost model: provide estimated cost per query breakdown (embedding lookup, rerank token cost, infra amortized). Client target: <$0.015 per successful deflection (combined retrieval+reply).

Customer quotes/feedback snippets:
- "Top-5 suggestions need to be relevant — a wrong high-ranked suggestion is worse than none."
- "We can trade some throughput for accuracy but can't lose the SLA for latency during business hours."

Security/legal notes:
- Legal requested a short memo on data residency and KMS key handling by 2026-03-20.
- NDA signed 2026-02-22.

Action items / next steps (AE/SE):
- Finish reranker sweep across three model candidates (open quantized LM, small cross-attention reranker, two-stage neural+bm25) — due 2026-03-18.
